## Before submitting

- [ ] I searched existing issues for duplicates and related proposals.
- [ ] I reviewed the MVP scope in README and removed sensitive information.

## Affected area

Documentation / CI / artwork generation / wallet / minting / listings / other:

## Problem / user need

Who needs this and why? Explain the outcome, not only the implementation.

## Proposed solution

Describe the intended user experience and scope. Indicate whether this is MVP work or a later enhancement; proposed technology choices are not yet approved decisions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Describe an observable, testable outcome.
- [ ] Include an error or failure case where relevant.

## Validation plan

How should a reviewer verify the change? Use testnet/test wallets for blockchain flows.

## Alternatives considered

## Dependencies and risks

Link related issues and unresolved decisions. Consider wallet safety, content rights, privacy, cost, metadata persistence, and transaction failures where relevant.

## Out of scope

## Additional context

Add mockups or references without secrets or private data.
